name: EXM_CREDIT_CARD_TRXNS
description: This table contains the details of corporate card transactions and summary details as provided by the card issuer. .

columns.name: CREDIT_CARD_TRXN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the corporate card transaction.

columns.name: MC_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Adjustment reason code provided by MasterCard.

columns.name: REQ_CNTL_ACCT_NUMBER
columns.description: Requesting control account number provided by AMEX for each of the transactions.

columns.name: VALIDATE_CODE
columns.description: Status indicating whether the corporate card transaction is validated and the error codes for invalid transactions.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Status of a corporate card transaction after validation, such as Valid and Invalid.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a corporate card program associated with the corporate card.

columns.name: COMPANY_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the company account associated with the corporate card.

columns.name: CARD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card in Oracle Fusion Expenses.

columns.name: CC_NETWORK_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier generated by the payment network for each corporate card authorization request.

columns.name: CARD_NUMBER
columns.description: Corporate card number. Stored only when card number is invalid.

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Corporate card transaction reference number provided by the card issuer in the charge file.

columns.name: AUTH_TRXN_NUMBER
columns.description: Authorization identifier provided by the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_NUMBER
columns.description: Employee number in the corporate card transaction file for a transaction charged to a company card.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of transaction, such as Purchase, Payment, and Finance Charges.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction occurred.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount charged at the time of transaction.

columns.name: DEBIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether this transaction is a debit or credit.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the transaction.

columns.name: BILLED_DATE
columns.description: Date of the statement on which the transaction appears.

columns.name: BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount billed to the corporate card account.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Billed amount provided by the card issuer in the feed file.

columns.name: BILLED_DECIMAL
columns.description: Number of decimal places used to display the billed amount.

columns.name: BILLED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the amount billed to the corporate card account.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_BILLED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Billed currency provided by the card issuer in the feed file.

columns.name: POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date the transaction was posted to the statement.

columns.name: POSTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the transaction posted to the statement.

columns.name: POSTED_DECIMAL
columns.description: Number of decimal places used to display the posted amount.

columns.name: POSTED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the transaction amount.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_EXPONENT
columns.description: Number of decimal places used to display currency conversion rate.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Rate used to convert the amount in billed currency to the payment currency.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_CURR_CONV_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting transaction amount or posted amount to billed amount.

columns.name: MIS_INDUSTRY_CODE
columns.description: Management Information System code that is specific to American Express, which is provided by the card issuer and identifies the type of transaction.

columns.name: SIC_CODE
columns.description: Standard Industrial Classification is a United States government system for classifying industries by a four-digit code.

columns.name: MERCHANT_TAX_ID
columns.description: Taxpayer identifier of the merchant who accepted the corporate card for this transaction.

columns.name: MERCHANT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Purchase identification of a transaction provided by the merchant at the point of sale.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME1
columns.description: Name of merchant or establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME2
columns.description: Name of merchant or establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ADDRESS1
columns.description: Address of merchant or establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ADDRESS2
columns.description: Address of merchant or establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ADDRESS3
columns.description: Address of merchant or establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ADDRESS4
columns.description: Address of merchant or establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CITY
columns.description: City where merchant or establishment is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_PROVINCE_STATE
columns.description: Province where merchant or establishment is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Zip or Postal code where merchant or establishment is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country where merchant or establishment is located.

columns.name: TOTAL_TAX
columns.description: Total tax charged for the transaction.

columns.name: LOCAL_TAX
columns.description: Local tax charged for the transaction.

columns.name: NATIONAL_TAX
columns.description: National tax charged for the transaction.

columns.name: OTHER_TAX
columns.description: Total of other taxes charged for the transaction.

columns.name: FOLIO_TYPE
columns.description: Corporate card expense types that are assigned to the transaction by the upload process.

columns.name: ATM_CASH_ADVANCE
columns.description: Amount of cash withdrawn from an Automatic Teller Machine with a card.

columns.name: ATM_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the Automatic Teller Machine transaction occurred.

columns.name: ATM_FEE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fee charged by the card issuer for the Automatic Teller Machine transaction.

columns.name: ATM_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Automatic Teller Machine.

columns.name: ATM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Automatic Teller Machine provided by the bank.

columns.name: ATM_NETWORK_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Automatic Teller Machine network provided by the bank.

columns.name: RESTAURANT_FOOD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total restaurant meal charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: RESTAURANT_BEVERAGE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total restaurant beverage charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: RESTAURANT_TIP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total restaurant tip amount in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: CAR_RETURN_DATE

columns.name: CAR_RENTAL_LOCATION
columns.description: Location where the car was rented.

columns.name: CAR_RENTAL_STATE
columns.description: State where the car was rented.

columns.name: CAR_RETURN_LOCATION
columns.description: Location where the car was returned.

columns.name: CAR_RETURN_STATE
columns.description: State where the car was returned.

columns.name: CAR_RENTER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the person renting the car.

columns.name: CAR_RENTAL_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days for which the car was rented.

columns.name: CAR_RENTAL_AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the rental agreement as provided by the car rental company.

columns.name: CAR_CLASS

columns.name: CAR_TOTAL_MILEAGE
columns.description: Total number of miles driven by the renter.

columns.name: CAR_GAS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fuel charges charged by the car rental company.

columns.name: CAR_INSURANCE_AMOUNT

columns.name: CAR_MILEAGE_AMOUNT

columns.name: CAR_DAILY_RATE

columns.name: HOTEL_ARRIVAL_DATE

columns.name: HOTEL_DEPART_DATE
columns.description: Departure date from the hotel.

columns.name: HOTEL_CHARGE_DESC
columns.description: Description of hotel charge as provided by the merchant.

columns.name: HOTEL_GUEST_NAME

columns.name: HOTEL_STAY_DURATION
columns.description: Number of days stayed at the hotel.

columns.name: HOTEL_ROOM_RATE
columns.description: Daily room rate for the hotel.

columns.name: HOTEL_NO_SHOW_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of a transaction due to the person not arriving at the hotel.

columns.name: HOTEL_ROOM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total room charges excluding room taxes in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_TELEPHONE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total telephone charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_ROOM_TAX

columns.name: HOTEL_RESTAURANT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total restaurant charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_BUSINESS_AMOUNT

columns.name: HOTEL_PARKING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total parking charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_ROOM_SERVICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total room service charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_TIP_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total tip amount charged to the card for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_MISC_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total miscellaneous charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_CITY
columns.description: City where the hotel is located.

columns.name: HOTEL_STATE
columns.description: State where the hotel is located.

columns.name: HOTEL_FOLIO_NUMBER
columns.description: Reference number assigned by the hotel to uniquely identify the reservation or stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_ROOM_TYPE
columns.description: Room type assigned by the hotel.

columns.name: AIR_DEPARTURE_DATE

columns.name: AIR_DEPARTURE_CITY
columns.description: Departure city of the flight.

columns.name: AIR_ROUTING
columns.description: Airport code for each leg of the trip.

columns.name: AIR_ARRIVAL_CITY
columns.description: Arrival city of the flight.

columns.name: AIR_STOPOVER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether a destination is a connection point or a final destination.

columns.name: AIR_BASE_FARE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Base air fare without any taxes.

columns.name: AIR_FARE_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Fare class for the airline ticket.

columns.name: AIR_SERVICE_CLASS
columns.description: Passenger class for leg of the trip.

columns.name: AIR_CARRIER_ABBREVIATION
columns.description: Alphabetic code that uniquely identifies an airline.

columns.name: AIR_CARRIER_CODE
columns.description: Code for the airline carrier for each leg of the trip.

columns.name: AIR_TICKET_ISSUER
columns.description: Name of airline or travel agency issuing the ticket.

columns.name: AIR_ISSUER_CITY

columns.name: AIR_PASSENGER_NAME

columns.name: AIR_REFUND_TICKET_NUMBER
columns.description: Ticket number of a refunded ticket.

columns.name: AIR_EXCHANGED_TICKET_NUMBER
columns.description: Ticket number for which this ticket was exchanged.

columns.name: AIR_AGENCY_NUMBER
columns.description: Identification code of the airline or travel agency issuing the ticket.

columns.name: AIR_TICKET_NUMBER
columns.description: Ticket number on the airline ticket.

columns.name: FINANCIAL_CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of the transaction as provide by the card issuer, such as New Charges and Payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether this transaction is a payment.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Type of record, such as header, trailer, or detail billing.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ACTIVITY
columns.description: Source of the transaction, such as a transaction by a merchant and an adjustment by a card issuer.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DUE_FROM_CODE
columns.description: Denotes the liability owner of the transaction.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: DISPUTE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the individual placed this transaction on dispute.

columns.name: TRXN_AVAILABLE_DATE

columns.name: CARD_ACCEPTOR_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the merchant who provides detail transactions for this transaction.

columns.name: TRXN_DETAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the transaction has detail transactions.

columns.name: REVIEWED_FLAG

columns.name: EARLY_DEPARTURE_CHARGES

columns.name: BILLING_CNTL_ACCT_NUMBER

columns.name: COMPANY_NUMBER

columns.name: INTERBANK_CARDASSOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number assigned by the processor to bank issuing corporate cards.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned by the payment processor that identifies a card issuer in the payment processor's system.

columns.name: AIR_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.description: Arrival date of the flight.

columns.name: AIR_TOTAL_FEES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total fees charged for airline ticket booking.

columns.name: HOTEL_CASH_DISB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total cash disbursement in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: HOTEL_TRANSPORTATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total transportation charges in a card transaction for a hotel stay.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Code assigned to the merchant by the credit card company that classifies the type of business.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BUSINESS_PROCESS_DATE
columns.description: Date when a corporate card transaction was processed by American Express.

columns.name: CORPORATION_NUM
columns.description: Corporation identifier assigned by American Express for remittance and reconciliation.

columns.name: GENESIS_DETAIL_INDUSTRY_CODE
columns.description: A sub-classification of Genesis Major industry codes for corporate card transactions.

columns.name: GENESIS_MAJOR_INDUSTRY_CODE
columns.description: American Express industry classification code for corporate card transactions.

columns.name: MERCHANT_BRAND_CODE
columns.description: The parent company code for the merchant where the charge was incurred.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CHAIN_NAME
columns.description: The parent company name for the merchant where the charge was incurred.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NUM
columns.description: The account number for the merchant where the charge was incurred.

columns.name: PROCESS_FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the upload process run on the transaction file.

columns.name: CC_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Unique identifier that maps authorization requests to credit card transactions in the transaction files when the files are uploaded to Expenses. The identifier links the original authorization data to all related transactions, such as reversals, adjustments, confirmations and chargebacks.

columns.name: EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_SENT_DATE
columns.description: The date and time when the email notification is sent for this charge.
